title: Zesty Dense Australian Pancetta Casserole
description: A rich and savory Australian dish featuring pancetta, confit-tomato, and a blend of spices, perfect for a special occasion. This shojin-friendly recipe is designed to be cooked in a fondue pot.
instructions: Preheat the fondue pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the vegetable broth, tomato paste, and olive oil.
Add the diced pancetta, chopped confit tomato, sliced mushrooms, chopped onion, and minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the dried thyme, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into the preheated fondue pot and cook for 30 minutes.
Stir the mixture every 10 minutes to prevent burning.
After 30 minutes, reduce the heat to 300 degrees Fahrenheit and simmer for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the fondue pot from the heat and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
